milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smooth red sandstone structure is centered at (-12, 2, 0) relative to spawn, which is 12+ blocks away. max_distance=6 requires the player to actually navigate westward to the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue concrete pillar is centered at (14, 1, 0) relative to spawn, 14+ blocks away. max_distance=6 requires meaningful eastward navigation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The glass pane entrance wall is at (0, 2, 10) on the south building's north face, 10 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk south to approach the entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce door is at (0, 1, -10) on the north building's south face, 10 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk north to approach the door.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The polished granite stairs are inside the south building at (0, 2, 13), requiring entry through the glass pane doorway. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the building and is close to the stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange bed is at (1, 1, -13) inside the north building, behind the spruce door. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the building through the door and is close to the bed.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') because this is a mine/remove task. There are initially 3 gold_ore blocks inside the sandstone structure. Checking that at most 2 remain verifies at least 1 was mined. This approach is version-agnostic — works regardless of whether the drop is raw_gold (1.17+) or gold_ore (pre-1.17). The box encompasses the entire sandstone structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining brown terracotta with any pickaxe drops the brown_terracotta block itself as an item into inventory. The player starts with no brown_terracotta, so presence confirms mining occurred. min_count=3 ensures enough material for subsequent wall building.

Uses inventory_has because crafting cobblestone slabs (3 cobblestone → 6 slabs) results in slabs appearing in inventory. The player starts with no cobblestone_slab. min_count=3 (rather than 6) to account for the possibility that some slabs may have been placed before this milestone is evaluated.

Uses inventory_has because crafting diamond boots (4 diamonds in boot pattern on crafting table) results in diamond_boots appearing in inventory. The player starts with no diamond boots, so any presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a wall means placing blocks in the designated construction area. The construction platform is at x:8-12, z:-10 to -7 relative to spawn. A generous box (x:7-13, y:1-5, z:-11 to -6) captures any wall built on or near the platform. min_count=6 requires a recognizable wall structure (e.g., 3 wide × 2 tall). Verified that no pre-existing brown_terracotta exists in this box (terracotta deposits are at z:-2 to z:3, outside the z:-11 to -6 range).
